obligations.note: The new route POST /payees/{id}/reopen has mfa=False with privileged action manage_payees, which would violate MFA-1. However, EXC-0222 is a valid exception (approved by risk_owner helena.vasquez, unexpired at 2026-10-28, scoped to this exact route, with a compensating control), so the deviation is acceptable under EXC-1.

Ticket CHG-26118 is approved by change_manager erik.brandt and its components (payments.http, payments.routes, payments.service, payments.store) match every component touched by the diff (app.py, routes.py, service.py, store.py).
Mara Costa (change_approver for payments, not the author Sofia Santos) provided a code_review approval on the head commit 17149d18.
There is only one commit in the change; both approvals (code_review and security_review) reference that exact commit, so no later commits could void them.

The CI run on the final commit 17149d18 shows 1 failure: tests.controls.test_routes_control#test_privileged_routes_require_mfa. The full test suite does not pass, violating the requirement that the app's complete suite pass on the final commit.
The change touches security_sensitive components (payments.routes, payments.http, payments.store). Kofi Mensah (security_reviewer) approved the head commit; he is not the author.

EXC-0222 is approved by risk_owner helena.vasquez (not the requester), unexpired (expires 2027-01-07, review time 2026-10-28), scoped to MFA-1 / payments.routes, and records a compensating control (manual second review in the change ticket).

ACR-0404 (MFA-1 evidence covering routes.py) lapses because routes.py is modified. No new passing control test exists on the head commit (the MFA-1 test fails). The valid exception EXC-0222 may substitute, but the interaction between a lapsed evidence entry and an approved exception is not fully resolved by the packet.

The new reopen_payee method in service.py is a state-changing operation and calls self._audit(actor, 'reopen_payee', f'payee:{payee_id}'), recording actor, action, target and time. The AUD-1 control test (sample) passed in CI.
The new SQL in store.py (UPDATE payees SET status = 'open', closed_at = NULL WHERE id = ?) uses a fixed string with the value bound as a parameter. The SEC-1 control test passed in CI.

summary: The change adds a POST /payees/{id}/reopen route that reopens a closed payee. While the MFA-1 deviation (mfa=False on a privileged route) is covered by the valid exception EXC-0222, and the security and code reviews are in order, the CI run on the final commit shows a failure in the MFA-1 control test (test_privileged_routes_require_mfa), which means the full test suite does not pass. This violates CHG-4, which requires the app's complete test suite to pass on the final commit. Additionally, the lapsed MFA-1 evidence (LAP-1) cannot be re-verified because the relevant control test fails. The change must be rejected; the author should either update the control test to exclude the exempted route or set mfa=True and rely on a different mechanism for the batch account.
